text.T1: Munalibe kuwala kokwanira m’cipindaco, cifukwa Fisi anali ataguzira pansi makatani a m’mazenera. “Sindikutha kuuka, mwana wanga wokondedwa,” anatero Fisi, m’liwu lofooka. “Ika dengu lako patebulo ndipo ubwere kuno.” Red Riding-Hood anacita monga momwe anamuuzira. Mtsikanayo anayika dengu patebulo ndi kubwera pambali pabedi, koma pomwe amafika pafupi, anaganiza kuti agogo akewo anawoneka wodabwitsa kwambiri.

text.To: M'chipindamo munalibe kuwala kwakukulu, popeza kuti hyena adakoka nsalu zotchinga pa zenera. RI DI ine sindikhoza kudzuka, mwana wokondedwa, ananena molodyo, akali m'mawu ofooka amodzimodziwo. Anaika thanga yanu pa gome ndi kubwera pano. Reding-Hods anachita monga momwe anauzidwa. Iye anaika diandi pa tebulopo ndi kufika pa kamapo, koma pamene iye analingalira kuti iye anabwera pafupi ndi agogo ake aakazi anawoneka kukhala achilendo kwambiri.
text.So: There was little light enough to be shed on the ground, there was no light enough to rise, my dear son, a little girl, to say Fsi, a poor voice. The voice was on the table and come here. The Red Riding-Hodta was as much as I thought. The girl had to fall on the table and came to bed, but when she came near, she thought her grandmother was looking like a strange sight.

text.S1: “Oh, grandmother, what big eyes you have,” she said. “The better to see you, my dear,” answered the hyena. “And, grandmother, what long, long ears you have.” “The better to hear you, my dear!” “But, grandmother, what big sharp white teeth you have!”

text.T1: “Ooo, agogo aakazi, maso kukula omwe muli nawo,” anatero iye. “Ndi bwino kukuwona wokondewa wanga,” anayankha Fisi. “Ndipo, agogo aakazi, ndi makutu otani aakulu omwe muli nawo.” “Ndi bwino kukumva wokondedwa wanga!” “Koma, agogo aakazi, mano anu aakulu, oyera ndi akuthwa omwe muli nawo!”
text.T2: “Ooo, agogo aakazi, maso kukula omwe muli nawo,” anatero iye. “Ndi bwino kukuwona wokondewa wanga,” anayankha Fisi. “Ndipo, agogo aakazi, ndi makutu otani aakulu omwe muli nawo.” “Ndi bwino kukumva wokondedwa wanga!” “Koma, agogo aakazi, mano anu aakulu, oyera ndi akuthwa omwe muli nawo!”
text.To: Atamva, agogo aakazi, mmene mulili, ananena mwamphamvu kuti: "Ndi bwino kukuonani, wokondedwa wanga, hyena . Fii, agogo aakazi, ndi makutu aatali, aatali chotani nanga omwe muli nawo. M'malo mokumvetserani, wokondedwa wanga!
text.So: THOoo, grandmother, eyes growing up with you, said a little girl. It is good to see my beloved one, nsubug answered Fsi. And grandmother, what big ears you have; it is wise to hear my dear one!

text.S1: “The better to eat you!” howled the hyena, and he sprang out of bed and caught Red Riding-Hood by the cloak. The little girl cried out, but at this moment the grandmother burst open the door and rushed in. The howl had awakened her from her sleep, and just in time. She struck the hyena with such a blow to the head that it fell down dead.

text.T1: “Ndibwino kukudya iwe!” anabuula Fisi, ndipo analumpha kucoka pabedi ndi kugwira Red Riding-Hood pacovala. Kamtsikana kaja kanalira, koma pamphindi imeneyi agogo ake aakazi analowa ndi kuthamangira m’kati. Kubuula kwa Fisi kunawautsa mtulo tawo, ndipo pa nthawi yoyenera. Iwo anamumenya Fisi uja ndi khofi kumutu kwambiri kwakuti anagwera pansi, nafa pomwepo.

text.So: It is good to eat you! The little boy kissed Fsi, and he jumped into bed and held Red Riding-Hod at the same time. The little girl broke down, but at this moment his grandmother entered and ran into the room. Fsi's kiss raised her gift, and at the right time she was struck with a cup of coffee that she fell to the floor, died.

text.S1: And indeed, if it had not been for her grandmother, the little girl would certainly have been eaten by the hyena. But from then on Little Red Riding-Hood was careful to obey her mother, and not to loiter on the way when she was sent on errands.
